$Comment: What the chest hidden in the Headless Horseman's graveyards holds, rolled fresh into it each time a party's graveyard is pasted (tools/arenas/ names it on the chest): two or three Uncommon Lantern Bombs every time, then each Choice below on its own when its Weight, its chance out of 100, comes up: a Rare and an Epic Lantern Bomb, and a Grave Candle. Keep the candle a chance, never certain: the chest refills every run, so a sure candle would make the gate free.
